reader.notes: The rule is enforced structurally: Run resolves data-name-2 only among the subject's preceding siblings (or the roots of its own section), so a lower-level entry between the pair puts data-name-2 out of scope and COBOL1654 refuses it. The diagnostic names the scope, not the 1985 rule, but it is correct and cites the 2023 counterpart.
